manifest.purpose: The golden answer file for the analysis_report submission. It must be valid JSON, identify the leaking register pair as ["share0_stage2_q", "share1_stage2_q"], state that both registers are safe under first-order analysis, and explain that the joint transition leaks when both update in the same clock cycle. The file must satisfy all functional requirements (FR1-FR4) and security requirements (SR1-SR3).
